# Lowkey Clean
 ![Default](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/08acff86224627393f71c1695f447b57de5e9781.png)![Lowkey Clean](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/725c4095103e446ae5117b97014d027fedc38328.png)
Lowkey Clean is a vanilla-style resource pack that keeps Minecraft feeling simple and smooth by cutting down on clutter in the GUI. It also shrinks item models, giving you more screen real estate and a cleaner HUD overall.

### Purpose:
- Smaller item models. Items appear smaller in your hand, reducing how much screen real-estate they take up.
- Dark, transparent GUI. Menus feel darker, cleaner, and less distracting while still staying easy to use.
